title: Larger mobile help button
summary: Increased the floating mobile help button and chat icon for easier recognition and tapping.

changes.detail: Increased mobile button from 48px to 64px and inner green circle from 34px to 50px, with a 27px chat glyph and stronger shadow. Preserved icon-only layout, unread badge and accessible label.
